title: Russian missile crashes in Poland during major attack on Ukraine
caption:
A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile crashed in a field in eastern Poland early on Friday, during a large Russian missile and drone attack on Ukraine that killed at least eight people, Ukrainian officials say. No one in Poland was hurt. Polish leaders called it a deliberate provocation timed with allied military exercises in the country, and Poland is asking NATO for more support.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
